note: Curated input. Acceptance gates named by ledger rows. Every gate is OPEN: nothing in this ledger is accepted, enabled, qualified or live. 'owner' is who must produce the evidence; dot independently verifies exact commits and records ACCEPT or HOLD for every gate (lane D).

STARTUP-COMPOSITION.title: Trusted startup composes the canonical owner
STARTUP-COMPOSITION.requirement: The capability's canonical owner is composed by reviewed trusted startup with durable authority and persistence; authenticated public paths are exercised against that exact composed artifact; unsupported controls report unavailable.
STARTUP-COMPOSITION.source: audit README outcome matrix 'Trusted product startup'; lifecycle-report L2; meri-audit-product-integration.md section 1

READ-ADAPTER.title: Typed gateway source adapter
READ-ADAPTER.owner: Fable lane B (apps/gateway/sources); Core/backend endpoint by dot
READ-ADAPTER.requirement: An adapter brief with exact inputs, outputs and policy denials; an operation-specific adapter under apps/gateway/sources listed in scripts/general-reads/adapters.json; canonical DTO preserved; no generic SQL or unrestricted query path.

READ-CONTEXT.title: Trusted dispatch context profile
READ-CONTEXT.owner: gateway shared file apps/gateway/dispatch/operation-context.mjs (one owner at a time) + dot for key semantics
READ-CONTEXT.requirement: Every contextKey the contract declares is supplied from a trusted source by a reviewed dispatch profile (proposal P5). Required only where the row's dispatchContext starts with 'missing:'.

READ-SERVER.title: General read server availability
READ-SERVER.owner: Fable (worker meri_reads server, gateway general-read mount); dot for contracts P1-P3, P8, P9; capability-policy lane for P8
READ-SERVER.requirement: The read appears in an ordinary no-skill conversation only through the six-gate intersection (contract, native installation receipt P2, capability policy P8, discovery grant P1, client scope, exclusion) with the base read budget allocation P3 and the options mount P11/P12; unavailable reads are absent or return a closed UNAVAILABLE error, never an empty success; per-call current authority stays authoritative.
READ-SERVER.source: FABLE-GENERAL-READ-TOOLS-20261015.md sections 2.3-2.8 and 7; audit data addendum 'Required design/acceptance correction'

READ-QUALIFICATION.title: Per-family read qualification (G3)
READ-QUALIFICATION.owner: Fable (tests) + dot (Core endpoint, ACCEPT, contract availability record) + native qualification owner (installation receipt)
READ-QUALIFICATION.requirement: Real SDK query through the approved proxy under the approved synthetic budget calls the mcp__meri_reads__ tool; gateway mount with real current-authority ports and durable Postgres budget/invocation owner; adapter reaches the dot Core endpoint for a dedicated synthetic tenant with broker-issued short-lived credentials; common assertions (policy matrix, receipts, cross-tenant/client/revocation/expiry/budget/deadline/cancel closed errors, argument authority refused, replay without second source call, output limit, process exit) plus family assertions; dot ACCEPT; contract owner records availability enabled / qualification qualified / handler sourceSha256. Offline or scripted runs are source evidence only.

SKILL-SUCCESSOR.title: Historical action-items successor decision
SKILL-SUCCESSOR.requirement: New skill versions name actions.query instead of the historical client-scoped query_action_items (P7); immutable 1.0.0 manifests are not changed in place; scoped and unscoped semantics are never silently aliased.
SKILL-SUCCESSOR.source: audit data addendum correction 2; FABLE-GENERAL-READ-TOOLS-20261015.md P7

INTENT-ROUTE.title: Governed conversational route for a product operation
INTENT-ROUTE.owner: Neo approval for the new meri_intents component (P10), then Fable; dot reviews
INTENT-ROUTE.requirement: A governed conversational path to the existing owner that only prepares (immutable proposal or draft version); effects run only after the existing approval control with fresh authority; UNKNOWN and replay handled; never exposed under readOnlyHint. A separate HTTP route or button alone is not conversational parity. Fallback if P10 is refused: typed structured-output intent.
INTENT-ROUTE.source: FABLE-GENERAL-READ-TOOLS-20261015.md section 3 and P10; audit README 'Corrected tool and scope accounting'

COMMAND-G5.title: Selected commands (G5)
COMMAND-G5.requirement: Immutable proposals, approval expiry, current authorization, revocation, idempotent outcomes and receipts pass; repeated delivery creates zero duplicate mutations; exact pending-candidate lineage and lost-ACK behaviour through the selected producer.

MEMORY-PRODUCER.title: Memory proposal producer and canonical review
MEMORY-PRODUCER.owner: Fable (command producer) + dot (canonical memory review owner in Core)
MEMORY-PRODUCER.requirement: Personal-scope pending producer exists (today PENDING_PRODUCER_UNAVAILABLE); firm/client/personal candidates stay pending until canonical review; no direct publish; real owner/client wall, lifecycle, grant, approval-expiry, replay and revoke evidence.
MEMORY-PRODUCER.source: data-artifacts-report.md 'Institutional memory'; docs/CAPABILITY-SCOPE.md memory.read and memory.propose

ARTIFACT-ADMISSION.title: Artifact family admitted by the document application
ARTIFACT-ADMISSION.requirement: The format/operation is admitted by format-admission only after its internal defects are repaired (DA-2 PDF revision lineage, DA-3 PPTX overlap); generation, inspection, preview and filing stay separate owners.
ARTIFACT-ADMISSION.source: audit README outcome matrix 'Editable native artifacts'; data-artifacts-report.md DA-2/DA-3

ARTIFACT-NATIVE.title: Native artifact qualification
ARTIFACT-NATIVE.requirement: Held-out cases: 100% native openability and supported formulas/reference totals correct; at least 95% human quality; no critical clipping or corruption; zero unauthorized disclosure; real storage/KMS identity; admitted renderer sandbox; revisions, previews and filing. Generator success, magic bytes and XML inspection do not qualify.
ARTIFACT-NATIVE.source: audit README 'End-to-end completion criteria'; docs/CAPABILITY-SCOPE.md 'Native artifacts and revisions'

ANALYSIS-SANDBOX.title: Analysis execution boundary
ANALYSIS-SANDBOX.owner: Fable lane C; approval needed for any new execution placement
ANALYSIS-SANDBOX.requirement: Typed pandas mode first; general program mode needs a separately admitted sandbox boundary; outputs stay pending inspection.

SCHEDULE-DISPATCH.title: Scheduled-run dispatch and UNKNOWN reconciliation
SCHEDULE-DISPATCH.owner: Fable lane A (runtime composition) + lane A/C (apps/control/schedules)
SCHEDULE-DISPATCH.requirement: A scheduled firing is mounted into current authority, fresh run binding and capability issuance; an exact-provider reconciliation entry point resolves UNKNOWN without blind redispatch or a second scheduler; claim/generation/expiry/cancel/recovery and duplicate-effect controls pass.

FEATURE-DESIGN-APPROVAL.title: Approved design for an owner-added first-shipment feature
FEATURE-DESIGN-APPROVAL.owner: Fable (proposal); Neo Martinez (approval of architecture, components and placement); dot (review)
FEATURE-DESIGN-APPROVAL.requirement: A written design names architecture, components (upstream first; no restrictive Office skill copies), placement, authority/approval path, isolation and qualification; the owner approves it before implementation.
FEATURE-DESIGN-APPROVAL.source: Owner decision of 15 Oct 2026 (FABLE-OWNER-DECISIONS-20261015.md); AGENTS.md change-approval rule

DEPLOY-G1-G7.title: Original deployment gates
DEPLOY-G1-G7.owner: dot (acceptance); AWS shipping owner alone for separately authorized cloud actions
DEPLOY-G1-G7.requirement: All original G1-G7 and product acceptance gates in docs/plans/MERI-DEPLOYMENT.md remain in force against one immutable integrated source/image; this ledger lowers none.

EXCLUDED-NEVER-REGISTERED.title: Excluded tool is never registered
EXCLUDED-NEVER-REGISTERED.requirement: The catalog original stays deferred with replacement null and zero contracts; the name is absent from catalog operations, SDK tool names and aliases, every skill manifest, the operation resolver, the general read server, the governed intent surface and the browser/workspace tool lists. Guarded by apps/worker/conversation/test/legacy-tools-excluded.test.mjs (875b3055) once integrated, and by the general-read inventory (deferred rows map to zero contracts).
EXCLUDED-NEVER-REGISTERED.source: owner direction 15 Oct 2026; commit 875b3055; FABLE-GENERAL-READ-TOOLS-20261015.md section 2.3 gate 6

EXCLUDED-NO-IMPLEMENTATION.title: No accidental implementation or dead code
EXCLUDED-NO-IMPLEMENTATION.requirement: Every file under apps/, packages/ and scripts/ that names an excluded tool is a classified non-implementation reference (scripts/scope-ledger/owner-exclusion.json knownReferences); an accidental implementation is deleted with its dead code rather than disabled.

EXCLUDED-NEUTRALIZE-GUIDANCE.title: Neutralize model-visible guidance naming an excluded tool

EXCLUDED-NEUTRALIZE-GUIDANCE.requirement: A successor contacts contract/note without the update_client_profile clause and registry guidance without create_client (P6); interim fixed notice block appended without rewriting canonical results.

EXCLUDED-RELEASE-NOTES.title: Exclusion stated in release notes
EXCLUDED-RELEASE-NOTES.requirement: Every excluded capability is listed in release notes as excluded by owner direction (15 Oct 2026); no release claim.
